title: On field calibration of an electronic nose for benzene estimation in an urban pollution monitoring scenario
read_depth: Publisher indexed abstract, DOI/title/bibliographic record, and UCI dataset citation checked.
supports: Neural calibration of a solid-state multisensor electronic nose for benzene estimation used conventional air-monitoring reference measurements and assessed prediction errors over an extended interval.
caution: Original urban electronic-nose study, not Nemesis hardware or field data; this does not supply calibration coefficients for MQ sensors.

title: Ridge Regression: Biased Estimation for Nonorthogonal Problems
read_depth: DOI bibliographic metadata checked; original abstract indexed by a scholarly index and authors’ later publisher abstract describe the 1970 method. Direct publisher page returned 403; full text not read.
supports: Foundational ridge-regression estimator adds a positive regularization term to the normal-equation diagonal for correlated predictors.
caution: Cite the original 1970 DOI, not the separately registered 2000 reprint. Predictive performance must be assessed on the chosen dataset.

title: CN0326: Isolated Low Power pH Monitor with Temperature Compensation
read_depth: Official technical page read, including circuit description, high-impedance input, guarding, temperature compensation, calibration, and test methods; source dated October 29, 2013.
supports: pH electrodes require suitable high-input-impedance buffering, leakage control and temperature-aware calibration.
caution: This is a reference circuit, not evidence that the described circuit or its reported performance is implemented on Nemesis.

title: Evaluation of measurement data — Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
authors: Joint Committee for Guides in Metrology
read_depth: Official BIPM publication and DOI landing metadata verified; used for the general measurement-uncertainty framework, not a claim of full-document review.
supports: General framework for evaluating and expressing measurement uncertainty.
caution: A cited framework does not constitute a completed uncertainty budget; the 2008 guide is identified explicitly, and the publisher also lists a 2026 amendment on nonlinear models.
